notes: Cressman, 14 October 1942: motor torpedo boats engage a Japanese surface force (Rear Admiral Kurita Takeo) comprising battleships Haruna and Kongo, light cruiser Isuzu, and seven destroyers bombarding Henderson Field, Guadalcanal. Confidence 0.5 (one official family). USSBS's 13 October bombardment sentence names only Haruna and Kongo, so it is not used as a second family for Isuzu. The JACAR 3rd Sentai diary names 2sd in the same Teishin Attack Force but does not name Isuzu on the pages read. The 14 November damage south of New Georgia, named by Cressman and USSBS, still has no coordinate precise enough for a pin and is not entered.
